summary: Statistics for Strava provides an analytical dashboard compiled directly from your fitness tracking data. It processes exported or synced records to visualise your training metrics and performance trends in a self-hosted environment.
goodFor: Athletes and data enthusiasts who want to privately visualise and analyse their fitness metrics beyond the standard web interface of their activity tracker.
watchOut: With a small community and low repository visibility, you may encounter edge cases or lack third-party support when troubleshooting issues. The AGPL-3.0 licence also places strict copyleft obligations on your deployment if you modify and expose the codebase over a network.
deployNotes: As a containerised application built with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
